name: GCSE Mathematics (OCR J560) — Foundation and Higher tier

selected_options.tiers_built: Both Foundation (grades 1-5) and Higher (grades 4-9) -- content overlaps substantially; each stage teaches the shared Foundation core first, then a clearly marked Higher-tier extension. Items whose OCR content is Higher-only are marked (Higher) in their titles.

material_vintage: OCR GCSE Mathematics (J560) specification, Version 2.1 (Aug 2026), current and live (first assessment 2017, ongoing); every OCR content reference code 1.01a-12.03d itemised on 2026-09-19 (code lists cross-checked across independent reads of the spec). Assessment structure and AO weightings from the specification; seed questions drawn from real OCR published papers (Foundation Paper 2 mark scheme, Nov 2018 series; Higher Tier Practice Papers Set 1) on ocr.org.uk. Stage test scenarios are original questions written in the style of those papers, not real past-paper items.
level_source: RQF Level 2 (GCSE, full grade range 1-9 / Foundation+Higher tiers covered), per Ofqual's Register of Regulated Qualifications listing for this specification
